Name: Pack and Preserve
Author: Eimakore
Description:
[size=6][b]Pack & Preserve Mod[/b][/size]

[b]Pack & Preserve[/b] expands Stardew Valley's production and shipping systems with bulk packaging, reusable containers, dynamic pricing, reversible crates, and preserved food.
Pack farm products into content-specific crates, preserve fish and meat in reusable cans, and automate the production of packaging materials with the Box-O-Matic.
Version 2.0 is a major rework of the mod. Pricing, crate data, canned food, profession handling, and several internal systems have been redesigned.

[heading][color=#cc0000][size=6]Important: Version 2.0 Requires a New Save[/size][/color][/heading]
Crates created by older versions do not contain the instance metadata required by the new pricing and unpacking systems. Migration from Pack & Preserve 1.x is not supported.
Do not update an existing 1.x playthrough to 2.0 if you want to keep using that save.
[line]
[size=5]Main Features[/size]
[heading][size=4]Packing Station[/size][/heading]
The Packing Station turns farm products into finished shipping crates.
Most recipes consume:
[b]5 items + 1 empty Crate[/b]
Supported categories include:
[list]
[*]Fruits[/*]
[*]Vegetables[/*]
[*]Forage[/*]
[*]Animal products[/*]
[*]Artisan goods[/*]
[*]Wine[/*]
[*]Juice[/*]
[*]Jelly[/*]
[*]Pickles[/*]
[*]Dried goods[/*]
[*]Smoked goods[/*]
[*]Canned fish and meat[/*]
[*]Cheese[/*]
[*]Honey[/*]
[*]Mead[/*]
[*]Aged Roe[/*]
[*]Many compatible modded artisan products[/*]
[/list]Coffee uses its own bulk recipe:
[b]15 Coffee Beans + 1 empty Crate[/b]
Crates are named according to their contents whenever the source item provides enough information.
Examples:
[list]
[*]Apple Crate[/*]
[*]Potato Crate[/*]
[*]Apple Wine Crate[/*]
[*]Strawberry Jelly Crate[/*]
[*]Pickled Pumpkin Crate[/*]
[*]Smoked Salmon Crate[/*]
[*]Canned King Salmon Crate[/*]
[*]Dried Rosemary Crate[/*]
[/list]Compatible modded flavored products can also preserve their specific names and metadata.
[line]
[heading]Dynamic and Locked Crate Prices[/heading]
Pack & Preserve 2.0 no longer relies on fixed profession-specific crate recipes.
Instead, the final value is calculated from the [b]actual item used as input[/b].
This includes:
[list]
[*]Base sell price[/*]
[*]Item quality[/*]
[*]Applicable profession bonuses[/*]
[*]Current profit margin[/*]
[*]The recipe's intended packing or processing premium[/*]
[/list]The resulting price is then [b]locked when the crate is produced[/b].
Changing professions later will not change the value of crates that already exist.
This also prevents profession bonuses from being applied a second time simply because an item was placed inside a crate.
For example, wine that already benefits from the Artisan profession will not receive another unnecessary Artisan bonus when the finished crate is sold.
Finished crates are classified as [b]Shipping Goods rather than Artisan Goods[/b].
[line]
[heading]Reversible Crates[/heading]
Finished crates can be opened again.
Opening a crate:
[list]
[*]Consumes one finished crate[/*]
[*]Returns the original items used to make it[/*]
[*]Restores the original quantity[/*]
[*]Restores quality[/*]
[*]Preserves flavor and preserve information[/*]
[*]Preserves colors where applicable[/*]
[*]Preserves dynamic item names[/*]
[*]Preserves relevant modded item metadata[/*]
[*]Does [b]not[/b] return the empty wooden crate[/*]
[/list]This also works with compatible modded products.
For example:
[b]Canned King Salmon -> Canned King Salmon Crate -> unpack -> Canned King Salmon[/b]
or:
[b]Dried Rosemary -> Dried Rosemary Crate -> unpack -> Dried Rosemary[/b]
Default Controls
[b]Keyboard and mouse:[/b]
Hold [b]Left Shift[/b] and [b]Right Click[/b] while holding a finished crate.
[b]Gamepad:[/b]
Hold [b]X[/b], then press [b]Left Shoulder[/b].
The keybind can be changed in the Pack & Preserve Code config.
[line]
[size=4]Canning Machine[/size]
The Canning Machine preserves fish and meat using reusable cans.
A normal recipe consumes:
[b]2 fish or meat + 1 empty Can[/b]
The finished product remembers the exact source used to create it.
Examples:
[list]
[*]Canned King Salmon[/*]
[*]Canned Tuna[/*]
[*]Canned modded fish[/*]
[*]Canned meat when Animal Husbandry Mod is installed[/*]
[/list]Different qualities remain separate and retain their correct value.
[line]
[heading]Canned Food Is Edible[/heading]
Unlike older versions of Pack & Preserve, canned products are now actual food.
Their nutrition is calculated dynamically from the source items used to make them.
By default:
[b]Combined nutrition of the consumed ingredients x 1.5[/b]
Since a normal can uses two source items, a finished can generally provides approximately three times the nutrition of one raw input item.
Negative Edibility is respected too. Canning a harmful food does not magically turn it into healthy food.
Pack & Preserve also fixes a vanilla tooltip edge case where an edible item restoring exactly [b]-300 Energy[/b] would normally have its Energy line hidden.
[line]
[heading]Reusable Empty Cans[/heading]
Eating Pack & Preserve canned food returns:
[b]1 Empty Can[/b]
The returned can can then be reused for another batch.
This creates a simple container cycle:
[b]Empty Can -> Canned Food -> Eat -> Empty Can[/b]
[line]
[size=4]Box-O-Matic[/size]
The Box-O-Matic is a packaging-material production machine designed for bulk workflows.
It automatically produces the containers used by Pack & Preserve, including:
[list]
[*]Empty Crates[/*]
[*]Empty Cans[/*]
[/list]It is especially useful with [b]Automate[/b], allowing packaging materials to be produced continuously from supplied resources.
[line]
[size=5]Crafting Recipes[/size]
[heading][size=4]Packing Station[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*]10 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]5 Refined Quartz[/*]
[*]1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list][heading][size=4]Canning Machine[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*]10 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]5 Refined Quartz[/*]
[*]2 Gold Bars[/*]
[/list][heading][size=4]Box-O-Matic[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*]10 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]5 Refined Quartz[/*]
[*]2 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]2 Battery Packs[/*]
[/list][heading][size=4]Wooden Crates[/size][/heading]
[b]1 Wood -> 2 Crates[/b]
or
[b]1 Hardwood -> 5 Crates[/b]
[heading][size=4]Empty Cans[/size][/heading]
[b]1 Iron Bar -> 5 Cans[/b]
[line]
[size=5][b]Recipe Unlock Modes[/b][/size]
Pack & Preserve includes three progression modes which can be selected in the config.
[heading]Progression[/heading]
This is the default mode.
Recipes are unlocked through gameplay and delivered through letters.
[spoiler]Packing Station and Wooden Crates
Mayor Lewis sends the blueprints after you:
[list]
[*]Earn at least 10,000g total[/*]
[*]Reach Farming Level 2[/*]
[*]Ship at least 50 items[/*]
[*]Reach the required friendship level with Lewis
[/*]
[/list]The letter unlocks both the [b]Packing Station[/b] and basic [b]Wooden Crate[/b] recipes.
Canning Machine and Empty Cans
Willy sends the blueprints after you:
[list]
[*]Earn at least 15,000g total[/*]
[*]Reach Fishing Level 3[/*]
[*]Catch at least 50 fish[/*]
[*]Reach Friendship Level 2 with Willy
[/*]
[/list]The letter unlocks both the [b]Canning Machine[/b] and [b]Empty Can[/b] recipes.
Hardwood Crate Recipe
Robin sends an improved crate-building method after:
[list]
[*]Receiving the Packing Station blueprint[/*]
[*]Chopping at least 15 Large Stumps
[/*]
[/list]This unlocks:
[b]1 Hardwood -> 5 Crates[/b]

Box-O-Matic
Maru sends the Box-O-Matic blueprint after:
[list]
[*]Receiving the Packing Station blueprint[/*]
[*]Receiving the Canning Machine blueprint[/*]
[*]Receiving the Hardwood Crate blueprint[/*]
[*]Reaching Friendship Level 3 with Maru[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[heading]Shop[/heading]
Machine recipes are sold at Robin's Carpenter Shop for [b]4,000g each[/b].
Packaging recipes are available immediately.
[heading]Unlocked[/heading]
All Pack & Preserve recipes are available immediately.
[line]
[size=5]Automate Support[/size]
Pack & Preserve has been tested with [b]Automate[/b].
Automate can:
[list]
[*]Supply Packing Stations[/*]
[*]Supply Canning Machines[/*]
[*]Operate the Box-O-Matic[/*]
[*]Produce dynamically named crates and cans[/*]
[*]Preserve locked prices and item metadata[/*]
[/list]Items produced through Automate use the same pricing and snapshot systems as manually produced items.
Automate is optional.
[line]
[size=5][b]Mod Compatibility[/b][/size]
Pack & Preserve uses context tags and Stardew Valley's preserve/flavor data wherever possible instead of maintaining enormous hardcoded lists.
This allows many compatible modded items to work automatically.
Special support is also included for several modded artisan-product types.
[heading]Animal Husbandry Mod[/heading]
Optional support is included for meat from [b]Animal Husbandry Mod[/b].
When installed, supported meats can be processed in the Canning Machine.
[heading]Modded Flavored Items[/heading]
Items which correctly expose preserve, flavor, and context-tag information can retain that information when packed and unpacked.
Some modded products use completely static names instead of Stardew's flavor system. In those cases Pack & Preserve may intentionally use a more generic crate name to avoid malformed names.
For example, some plant milks may produce:
[b]Nut Milk Crate[/b]
instead of a flavor-specific name such as Pecan Milk Crate.
This is intentional compatibility behavior.
[line]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Pack & Preserve 2.0 requires:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b][/*]
[*][b]Extra Machine Config[/b][/*]
[*][b]Mail Framework Mod[/b][/*]
[/list]Optional:
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for easier configuration[/*]
[*][b]Automate[/b][/*]
[*][b]Animal Husbandry Mod[/b][/*]
[/list]Pack & Preserve 2.0 also includes its own SMAPI code component. Both parts of the mod are required.
[line]
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Install Extra Machine Config.[/*]
[*]Install Mail Framework Mod.[/*]
[*]Install any optional compatibility mods you want to use.[/*]
[*]Extract the Pack & Preserve download into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Make sure both Pack & Preserve components are present.[/*]
[*]Start a [b]new save[/b] for Pack & Preserve 2.0.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Notes[/b]
Pack & Preserve is designed around [b]bulk processing and convenience without making the original products irrelevant[/b].
Packaging provides a reward for investing resources, machines, containers, and production time, while the final value still remains connected to the actual item that went into the machine.
Version 2.0 focuses on making crates and canned goods behave like real item containers rather than generic products with predetermined prices.
